svg.title: PCHIP comparison for SARAH PV sampling

cc:Work.dc:title: PCHIP comparison for SARAH PV sampling
cc:Work.dc:description: Compare PCHIP on original half-hour converted PV and existing hourly outputs; integrate using antiderivatives; reconstructive assumption, not physical ground truth.

g.text: Right panel uses exact PCHIP antiderivative differences over [t,t+1h), not point samples or four quarter-hour averages.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596579

g.text: Interpolation assumes point-sample inputs. Current hourly outputs mix averaged radiation and first-slot geometry.

g.text: Reconstructed power, not measured interval energy. CSi, slope 18 degrees, south-facing. Atlite c428beeeb7; SciPy PchipInterpolator.
